description: The Distributed Systems Laboratory at the Federal University of Campina Grande collected operational records from its private OpenStack cloud in Brazil. The Data in Brief article reports more than 64 million records gathered continuously over nearly twelve months. The Mendeley Data version 2 release contains one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Its description identifies seven linked tables for projects, users, virtual machines, OpenStack hardware flavors, quotas, ownership and resource-usage metrics. These are cloud-operations observations that can inform server-capacity and virtual-machine placement simulations, not electricity meter readings or a ready-made data-centre simulator. A known limitation is coverage of one academic private cloud with its particular workload and management policies, which may not transfer to commercial installations. A reviewer-assessed use is testing allocation or utilisation assumptions in digital-infrastructure models. data-google-cluster-workload-traces and data-alibaba-cluster-trace-program are related cloud workload collections from different operators; no schema harmonisation was attempted. The article cites version 1, while the public repository now names version 2. No archive was downloaded or analysed.
